## Key Findings
1. **Core Workflow Functionality**: The core meeting intelligence workflow is operational, allowing users to upload transcripts for processing, resulting in decisions, action items, risks, and summaries.
2. **Extraction Logic Improvement**: The current system incorrectly treats vague suggestions as commitments. Rohan will modify the extraction logic to ensure confirmed actions are created only with explicit ownership or commitment.
3. **UI Updates**: Rohan will update the UI to display low-confidence items separately as possible actions in the Wednesday evening build.

5. **Jira Integration**: ARC will not automatically create Jira tickets during the pilot; instead, it will recommend actions for user approval, ensuring governance transparency.
6. **Model Latency**: Model latency is a concern but will not block the pilot unless it becomes frequent. A processing state will be displayed in the UI.
7. **Audit Trail Requirements**: Audit logging will be enhanced to include consistent model version logging alongside tool calls and timestamps.

eventId.description: The unique Microsoft Graph ID of the event

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Schedules a calendar event with attendees, agenda, and optional online Teams meeting (POST /me/events).

isOnlineMeeting.description: Whether to generate a Microsoft Teams online meeting link

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Modifies timing, attendees, location, or agenda of an existing event (PATCH /me/events/{id}).

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Cancels a meeting and removes it from the calendar (DELETE /me/events/{id}).

eventId.description: The event ID to cancel / delete

tools.name: accept_event
tools.description: Formally accepts a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/accept).

tools.name: decline_event
tools.description: Declines a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/decline).

tools.name: tentatively_accept_event
tools.description: Tentatively accepts a calendar meeting invitation (POST /me/events/{id}/tentativelyAccept).

eventId.description: The event ID to tentatively accept

tools.name: find_meeting_times
tools.description: Checks free/busy availability of requested attendees and suggests optimal meeting slots (POST /me/findMeetingTimes).

meetingDurationMinutes.description: Duration of the proposed meeting in minutes (default: 30)

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts from the user personal address book (GET /me/contacts).

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Retrieves complete profile, emails, phones, and job title of a contact (GET /me/contacts/{id}).

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Adds a new person to the address book (POST /me/contacts).

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Updates information for an existing contact (PATCH /me/contacts/{id}).

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Removes a contact from personal address book (DELETE /me/contacts/{id}).

tools.name: list_todo_lists
tools.description: Enumerates Microsoft To Do task lists and folders (GET /me/todo/lists).

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists tasks within a specific To Do list (GET /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks).

listId.description: The To Do list ID (or default list if omitted)

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Creates a new task in Microsoft To Do (POST /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks).

listId.description: Optional list ID (uses default task list if omitted)

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Updates task title, completion status, or due date (PATCH /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks/{taskId}).

listId.description: The list ID containing the task

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task from Microsoft To Do (DELETE /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks/{taskId}).

listId.description: The list ID containing the task

tools.name: list_message_rules
tools.description: Lists automated inbox sorting, forwarding, and categorization rules (GET /me/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules).

tools.name: get_mailbox_settings
tools.description: Inspects user timezone, working hours, language, and automatic Out-of-Office (OOO) status (GET /me/mailboxSettings).

tools.name: create_message_rule
tools.description: Creates an automated server-side inbox rule for sorting, moving, or forwarding messages (POST /me/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules).

actions.description: Actions to perform (e.g. moveToFolder, markAsRead, assignCategories)

tools.name: delete_message_rule
tools.description: Permanently deletes an automated inbox rule (DELETE /me/mailFolders/inbox/messageRules/{id}).

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieves authenticated user identity, primary mailbox email, display name, and tenant ID (GET /me).

tools.name: get_automatic_replies
tools.description: Inspects active Out-of-Office (OOO) automatic reply status, internal/external reply text, and schedule (GET /me/mailboxSettings/automaticRepliesSetting).

tools.name: set_automatic_replies
tools.description: Configures Out-of-Office (OOO) auto-replies, status (disabled, alwaysEnabled, scheduled), and messages (PATCH /me/mailboxSettings).

scheduledStartDateTime.description: Start time if status is scheduled

scheduledEndDateTime.description: End time if status is scheduled

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists all master color categories defined in the user Outlook account (GET /me/outlook/masterCategories).

basis.provider: Microsoft Graph API v1.0 / Official Outlook MCP Specification
